column1: # btn vectors. One fresh process per scenario (statics reset). Poll n is the n-th 10 ms input-loop iteration of the scenario.
# columns: scenario, poll, events_hex, external, expected_actions ('-' none). external: '-' | wake | sleep | reqoff (applied before that poll).
# init rows: scenario, init, key, value (asleep 0/1, wifi 0/1 connected, poweroff ok|fail, caption text). Defaults: awake, wifi down, caption READY, poweroff fails (returns).
# Poll numbers not listed have events 0 and must be run (they advance the aux hold counter). Actions in one poll joined by '|' in order.

# ptt_down/ptt_up/ptt_down_wake = events posted; sleeping(x)/waking(x) = set-asleep change with reason word x; notify_input = input task kicked out of its wait; wifi_apply; caption=T; update_power; shutdown; progress=0|level=0|mode=off; delay=N ms; board_power_off; mode=idle.
